expected_response.basis: No registered bounded edit can express the supported pair-shell, shape-tensor or joint-motion contrasts; centroid and temporal edits are unsupported.
expected_response.expected_effect: No change to the executing pointcloud scalar; incumbent pointcloud_delta_A=1.0, teacher_neighbors=4, mixture_temperature=0.5 and teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2=4.0 preserved.

failure_modes: A pair_kernel_1.5-5.0 selection contrast reverses sign or its batch agreement falls below the observed 0.857-1.0 fraction in independent batches.
A batch shows positive shape_yy contrast with same-sign agreement, or a region where local_cyy enrichment is positive.
A batch shows positive joint_internal_RMS_A contrast with same-sign agreement, or the teacher contrast internal fraction collapses toward translation/rotation.
A feature shows significant population_rate with non-significant edge_rate/residual, supporting within-path change instead of cohort composition.
A curve with zero strong sign conflicts, relative RMSE at or below 0.35 and a validated fit would permit a time-conditioned rule.
Decoded terminal labels becoming available and showing last-record credit agrees with final affinity benefit.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest reproducible signed contrasts are selection-enrichment contrasts on short-range pair-distance shell densities (pair_kernel_1.5-5.0 positive, pair_kernel_7.0 negative; endpoint_effects:9-13, branch_adjusted:163/164/240/241), but the executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit; observable_definitions scope). No registered bounded edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) can express a pair-shell or shape-tensor term, so the supported contrasts remain descriptive rather than operative. The shape_yy/shape_xx negative contrasts (endpoint_effects:3/4; branch_adjusted:158/235) and the joint internal/innovation negative branch-adjusted contrasts (branch_adjusted:74/76/151/153) are likewise not expressible by the pointcloud curvature or teacher-count parameters. Global centroid contrasts are non-reproducible (endpoint_effects:0-2; branch_adjusted:77/231), so no region_index or pointcloud_delta_A change is justified by them. The continuous contrast curves show many sign changes, strong sign conflicts and no accepted polynomial fit, and the curve-fidelity audit disallows Legendre runtime use (continuous:0-19; curve_support), so a temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend edit is not supported. Turnover and increment views disagree in direction with the endpoint ordering for several features (turnover:1/2/14/17/47/134/224/227/254/257/497/524/584/587; increment_effects:3/4/7/10/13/14/15/25/34/63), and survival credit is weak and not decoded terminal affinity (survival_effects:0/23/46/56/70/75/96/100/106/146/156/165/186/249/326/366/377/396; decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available false; lineage_support; information_audit). Because no permitted edit has a defensible expected advantage under the affinity-first objective, retaining the incumbent is the correct choice; temperatures remain fixed and were not proposed.
